new.title: What would you like to build?
new.description: A task is a brief with acceptance criteria. Its pipeline runs it step by step in a worktree of its own.

edit.title: Edit task
edit.description: Changes apply to draft {{key}}. Nothing runs until you choose Create & run.
edit.descriptionRan: {{key}} already ran. Changes apply to future runs only; its runs keep the brief they started with.

queued.description: Saved as {{key}}. The fields stay locked while its run waits to start.
queued.unconfirmedDescription: Saved as {{key}}. The runner did not say whether its run started; Retry run never creates a second run.
queued.retryNote: Retry run starts the run that is already queued. It never creates a second run.

noRun.title: No run is recorded for this task
noRun.body: {{key}} was saved and queued, but the runner never started its run. Retry run starts it; it never creates a second run.

progress.creatingForRun: Saving the task. Its run is queued right after.
progress.starting: Waiting for the runner to start the run.
progress.creatingDraft: Saving a draft. Tasks opens next with the new task highlighted.

kept.note: Your changes from {{time}} were kept on this computer. Save them, or discard them to return to the saved draft.
kept.noteNew: Your changes from {{time}} were kept on this computer. Create the task, or discard them to start again.
kept.noteRan: Your changes from {{time}} were kept on this computer. Save them for future runs, or discard them to return to the saved task.

project.label: Project
project.description: New tasks go to the current project.

criteria.label: Acceptance criteria
criteria.description: Reviewers check the result against each one.
criteria.placeholder: A check the result must pass
criteria.name: Criterion {{number}}

pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Runs the task step by step. Only published pipelines are listed.
pipeline.none: No published pipelines in this project
pipeline.missingKept: Saving keeps it as the task's pipeline; choosing one here replaces it for every member.

module.label: Module
module.description: The epic, milestone or sprint the task counts toward.

budget.label: Run budget
budget.description: Tokens the run may use. Leave empty for no limit.
budget.noLimitReadBack: No limit · the run uses what it needs

timeLimit.label: Time limit
timeLimit.description: Active agent time only. Leave empty for no limit.
timeLimit.noLimitReadBack: No limit · the run takes the time it needs

noAutomaticMerge.label: Don't merge automatically
noAutomaticMerge.description: The Orchestrator never merges this task's runs on its own, even when you let it merge finished runs: it tells you a run is ready and the merge stays yours.

context.label: Attach context
context.description: Files, links and notes for the agents.
context.reason: Attaching context is not available yet.

instructions.label: Included instructions
instructions.description: Project, agent and pipeline instructions are included automatically.

plan.title: Execution plan
plan.noGates: This pipeline has no approval gates.
plan.choose: Choose a pipeline to see its execution plan.

reasons.nothingChanged: Save changes unavailable: nothing has changed.
reasons.ranNoRun: Create & run is not offered: this task already has a run.

need.title: add a task title
need.noPipelines: no published pipeline in this project
need.keepComplete: a task that ran keeps a brief, criteria and a pipeline
need.newerVersion: save your changes on the newer version first

discard.question: Discard your changes to {{key}}?
discard.consequence: The draft stays as it was last saved.
discard.consequenceRan: The task stays as it was last saved.

load.failed: The project's tasks cannot be read
load.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or its key changed when the project was shared.

conflict.notice: A newer version of {{key}} was saved while you were editing
conflict.noticeBy: {{name}} saved a newer version of {{key}} while you were editing
conflict.noticeBody: Both versions are shown for each field that differs. Choose one per field, then save. Fields only one version changed are kept as they are.
conflict.unpublishedPipeline: A pipeline without a published version
conflict.unchosen: Save unavailable: choose a version for {{fields}}.
conflict.changedMeanwhile: This task changed meanwhile, so nothing was saved. Its newer version is read again.
